subject: Security ops shuttle: SOC 2 + DPA + pen test orientation — slot options

Subject: SOC 2 / DPA / pen orientation — request for evening slot (90m)

Hi Maya,

Thanks for taking this through — we need a combined orientation with your security/ops team to cover SOC 2 scope alignment, DPA review items, and a quick run-down of the upcoming third-party pen test schedule. We expect ~8 internal attendees (engineering, infosec, procurement).

Constraints:
- APAC teammates are available only before 03:00 UTC (so we'll need an evening UTC option to include them).
- Our pen vendor needs a 30-minute onboarding slot during the session.

Can Redwood propose two evening/night options this week? Preferably a 90-minute window. Also please share the evidence checklist and any pre-read.

Thanks,
Evan
Security Program Manager
Clearline Financial

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear constraints. We can run a combined session and will include our Security Lead (Olga) and Sales ops for procurement handoff (Ben).

Quick options (all 90m):
- Option A: Tue, 26 Oct, 19:00–20:30 UTC (Tue evening US friendly, 02:00–03:30 AEST)
- Option B: Wed, 27 Oct, 02:00–03:30 UTC (late night, covers APAC before 03:00 UTC)

Plan for the call: 10m intro + 30m SOC 2 controls/Q&A + 20m DPA/high-level terms + 30m pen vendor onboarding & ops bridge walk-through. We'll hold an ops bridge and record for distribution.

I've attached our evidence checklist and a one-click DPA DocuSign link to speed procurement. Also attaching an .ics for the ops bridge (placeholder) — we'll replace with the live invite once slot is chosen.

Can you confirm preference and whether the pen vendor (name + point of contact) should join live or be in a pre-call? If joining live, please CC them on the confirmation so we can send vendor-specific onboarding.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist.pdf, Redwood_DPA_DocuSign_Link.txt, ops-bridge-invite.ics

Thanks — will hold both proposed slots until Evan confirms.
